subject: Help with unmarked distsamp model selection error - "no method for assigning subsets of this S4 class"

messages.author: 77fa2bc3ece64945
messages.subject: Help with unmarked distsamp model selection error - "no method for assigning subsets of this S4 class"
parts:
Hello,

I have tried searching for a solution to this error, but have been unable to find anything.  Hence I am seeking guidance here.

I am using code derived from the ISSJ example using the unmarked distsamp function from section 8.4.3 in Kery and Royle's AHM Vol 1 (2016) in RStudio to analyse elephant dung distance sampled data for Mount Kenya, as a part of my PhD.  I have been undertaking forward stepwise model selection using site covariates and creating a list to store the models and a fitList and model selection table.  

I am having a problem fitting more complex models where it returns the below error:

> fall.modsel$hr.Wet1.LCDBoundSlopeDEMWet1 <- distsamp(~pr_Wet1_gg ~LCCode + DistBound + MK_slope_r + MKL10mBuff + pr_Wet1_gg, 
+                                                  mk.umf, keyfun = "hazard", output = "density", unitsOut = "kmsq")

Error in `$<-`(`*tmp*`, hr.Wet1.LCDBoundSlopeDEMWet1, value = new("unmarkedFitDS",  : 
  no method for assigning subsets of this S4 class

What is odd is that it only sometimes returns this error (i.e. the exact same model can run one time, with no error, but then fail and return the error another time).  Then, once this error has been returned, it returns a further error when i call the fitList and model selection table. 

> (fall.modsel <- modSel(fitList(fits=fall.modsel)))

Error in names(fits) <- as.character(1:(length(fits))) : 
  invalid to use names()<- on an S4 object of class 'unmarkedModSel'

Therefore I have been recreating 'fall.modsel' as an empty list and starting again, losing all the models I have already fitted.

Is this something to do with the length of the names I am using for the models?  Or something else?

I can provide further code if needed...

Any help much appreciated.

With thanks in advance,

Gwili

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: Help with unmarked distsamp model selection error - "no method for assigning subsets of this S4 class"
parts:
Hi Gwili,

What happens when you run the problematic model a few times *without* trying to save the output directly into a list? Do some runs still result in an error? If so is it the same error or a different one? I doubt it has anything to do with the names.

This is pretty tough to troubleshoot without a reproducible example to play with. If you can give one it'll be easier to help. 

As a potential workaround I would suggest running each model and saving the output as separate objects and only after it seems like they've all run properly to put them into a list and then convert it to a fitList.

Ken
